images.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a new simplified brewery trade emblem derived from the provided Gortach coat of arms (reference only, do not replace the original). The original depicts two affectionate companions embracing while holding beer mugs, a blue field and golden ornamental rim. For small product labels translate that idea into TWO GOLDEN TANKARDS with inward-linked handles, slightly tilted together in a toast, white foam, above two minimal golden wave lines. A round dark navy blue field, a restrained antique gold Celtic knot border. Flat clean ink linework and cel shaded fantasy heraldry, legible compact silhouette, only navy, gold, cream. No people, no crowns, no fleurs-de-lis, no words, no lettering. The emblem fills the square composition; real transparent background outside the circular seal. This is a new brewery mark for a Celtic fantasy family.
